description: Set where a listed surgeon stands (target, contacted, trialing, using_us, competitor, lost, passed) or add a note to their thread, e.g. after a call. The stage is the account's own, for the surgeon in general: it reads the same on every list and the profile, and set_account_status sets it for one product segment. using_us (or its old name, customer) also marks them as the rep's customer for warm_paths; moving off it unmarks them.

note.description: Adds a note to the surgeon's thread on this list; earlier notes stay.

npi.description: 10-digit NPI; use search to find it.

name: update_list_item
title: Update a surgeon on a list
